G1_unambiguity.justification: The wiring and sensor conditions clearly specify that every listed pair must receive different circuit assignments, including the explicitly addressed self-pair case.

G2_completeness.justification: The statement provides the necessary bounds, index ranges, input format, output format, feasibility condition, lexicographic tie-break rule, and edge-case behavior.

G3_faithfulness.justification: Assigning fixtures to two circuits with every monitored pair on different circuits is exactly equivalent to assigning workers to two shifts so that conflicting pairs differ, including the same-variable case.

G4_naturalness.justification: The lighting-system framing is coherent and readable, though the invented differential-sensor terminology is somewhat more elaborate than necessary for the underlying graph-coloring task.
